summary: Insufficient evidence — no qualifying results. Zero of the 20 base records satisfy every business rule after applying admissible updates. The most common disqualifiers are executed amendments (2026-08-20) that relocate seven Dallas records to Seattle (R1118, R3402, R5151/R2663, R7201, R7702, R7833, R8900) and thus move them out of the Dallas scope, plus one Dallas record that received an executed maturity extension to 2028-09-30 (R8900). The remainder fail on other single rules: inferred maturity (R2813), unconfirmed maturity + unresolved extension (R4743), out-of-window executed maturity (R1776), status_unknown (R7436), released loan (R9426), Office asset (R5181), property-manager owner relation (R4927), stale ownership verification (R1203), former employment (R7919), non-qualifying contact role Registered Agent (R9169), Seattle base market (R5451), and post-cutoff publication (R5442). No Dallas industrial loan with an executed, unextended-or-amended 2026-09-01–2027-08-31 maturity, a record-owner verified since 2026-03-01, and a current CFO / Head of Acquisitions / Director of Finance verified since 2026-03-01 remains.
limitations: outstanding_balance_usd is null on every base record and therefore unknown — not zero — for all candidates; only original_principal_usd was available.
Entity-level executed amendments were applied to duplicate records of the same entity (e.g., U-R5151-4 applied to both R5151 and R2663 for FIR-REF-74682).
Unsigned draft U-R7702-3 was excluded per the rule that unsigned drafts do not override the base extract.
Recorded release U-R1118-2 (2026-09-10) and base record R5442 (published 2026-09-03) are dated after the 2026-08-31 cutoff and were not applied/considered.
No SPV-to-parent mappings were supplied in the packet, so no SPV-to-parent consolidation was performed; entity-level dedup was performed on entity_id (R2663 and R5151 both point to FIR-REF-74682).
Email is treated as optional; had a Dallas record otherwise qualified with a null email (e.g., R7201 before its Seattle amendment), it would have been listed with contact_email: null.
